
== CreateWebsite with a copy
steps: Create Unix user | Copy databases | Pull and check image signature | Start container in gVisor | Configure edge proxy | Get TLS certificate
long: true
$ install -d -m 0711 $DIR/homes $DIR/sites
$ install -d -m 0711 $DIR/homes $DIR/sites
$ chmod 0700 $DIR/homes/staging_ab12
$ install -d -o root -g staging_ab12 -m 0750 $DIR/sites/staging_ab12
$ install -d -o staging_ab12 -g staging_ab12 -m 0750 $DIR/sites/staging_ab12/app
$ loginctl enable-linger staging_ab12
$ runuser -u staging_ab12 -- mkdir -p -m 0750 $DIR/sites/staging_ab12/app/public
$ systemctl start user@20001.service
$ runuser -u acme_x7k2 -- tar --create --file=- --directory=$DIR/sites/acme_x7k2/app -- . | runuser -u staging_ab12 -- tar --extract --file=- --directory=$DIR/sites/staging_ab12/app --no-same-owner --preserve-permissions
$ ip address replace 169.254.80.1/20 dev lo
$ systemctl daemon-reload
$ install -d -o root -g root -m 0711 $DIR/cf-db $DIR/cf-db/servers $DIR/cf-db/homes
$ chmod 0700 $DIR/cf-db/homes/db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3
$ loginctl enable-linger db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3
$ systemctl start user@10003.service
$ install -d -o root -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3 -m 0750 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3
$ install -d -o root -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3 -m 0750 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3/disk
$ install -d -o db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3 -g db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3 -m 0700 $DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3/disk/data
$ runuser -u db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/10003 podman image exists ghcr.io/cloudfactory/valkey:latest
$ systemctl --user --machine=db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3@ daemon-reload
$ systemctl --user --machine=db-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3@ restart cf-valkey-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3.service
$ runuser -u staging_ab12 -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/20001 podman pull --quiet ghcr.io/cloudfactory/frankenphp-php8.4:8.4.0-1
$ systemctl --user --machine=staging_ab12@ daemon-reload
$ systemctl --user --machine=staging_ab12@ restart cf-staging_ab12.service
result dnsPointsHere: true
result port: 20000
result valkey: map[staging_ab12_cache:1]

== CreateWebsite with a copy of a Valkey database
refused: a backup and a staging copy do not include Valkey databases
valkey> AUTH default
valkey> INFO server
valkey> AUTH default
valkey> ACL LIST
valkey> SELECT 1
valkey> FLUSHDB
valkey> ACL SETUSER staging_ab12_cache reset on >PASSWORD resetkeys ~* resetchannels &staging_ab12_* db=1 +@all -@admin -@dangerous +info +keys +flushdb +sort +sort_ro +client|setname +client|setinfo +client|id +client|getname +client|info +client|reply +client|no-touch -function -fcall -fcall_ro -script|flush -script|kill -pubsub -move -client|tracking -client|trackinginfo -client|caching -client|getredir
valkey> ACL SAVE

--- $DIR/units/10003/cf-valkey-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3.container (-rw-r--r--)
  # Managed by the Cloudfactory agent. The agent replaces changes to this file.
  [Unit]
  Description=Cloudfactory Valkey database server 01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3
  
  [Container]
  ContainerName=cf-valkey-01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3
  Image=ghcr.io/cloudfactory/valkey:latest
  Pull=never
  GlobalArgs=--runtime=/usr/local/bin/runsc --runtime-flag=platform=systrap --runtime-flag=network=sandbox --runtime-flag=ignore-cgroups
  PublishPort=169.254.80.2:6379:6379
  Label=io.cloudfactory.service=valkey
  NoNewPrivileges=true
  DropCapability=all
  UserNS=keep-id:uid=999,gid=999
  User=999
  Group=999
  ReadOnly=true
  Tmpfs=/tmp
  Volume=$DIR/cf-db/servers/01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3/disk/data:/data:Z
  Exec=valkey-server --bind 0.0.0.0 --port 6379 --databases 1024 --aclfile /data/users.acl --appendonly yes --save "" --maxmemory 448mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
  Label=io.cloudfactory.database-server=01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3d3
  Label=io.cloudfactory.customer=01jbq3z5k8n6t4w2x9y7r5p3c1
  StopTimeout=60
  
  [Service]
  Restart=always
  TimeoutStartSec=900
  CPUQuota=100%
  MemoryMax=1073741824
  MemorySwapMax=0
  
  [Install]
  WantedBy=default.target
--- $DIR/units/20001/cf-staging_ab12.container (-rw-r--r--)
  # Managed by the Cloudfactory agent. The agent replaces changes to this file.
  [Unit]
  Description=Website acme.example
  
  [Container]
  ContainerName=cf-staging_ab12
  Image=ghcr.io/cloudfactory/frankenphp-php8.4:8.4.0-1
  Pull=never
  GlobalArgs=--runtime=/usr/local/bin/runsc --runtime-flag=platform=systrap --runtime-flag=network=sandbox --runtime-flag=ignore-cgroups
  Network=pasta
  PublishPort=169.254.77.1:20000:8080
  PodmanArgs=--no-hosts
  Volume=$DIR/config/staging_ab12/hosts:/etc/hosts:ro
  Volume=$DIR/sites/staging_ab12/app:/app:Z
  Volume=$DIR/config/staging_ab12/php.ini:/usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/zz-cloudfactory.ini:ro,Z
  Label=io.cloudfactory.website=01JBQ3Z5K8N6T4W2X9Y7R5P3M1
  Environment=SERVER_NAME=:8080
  Environment=CF_DOCUMENT_ROOT=/app/public
  NoNewPrivileges=true
  DropCapability=all
  ReadOnly=true
  Tmpfs=/tmp
  UserNS=keep-id
  LogDriver=k8s-file
  PodmanArgs=--log-opt=path=$DIR/homes/staging_ab12/website.log --log-opt=max-size=10mb
  
  [Service]
  Restart=always
  TimeoutStartSec=300
  CPUQuota=100%
  MemoryMax=1073741824
  MemorySwapMax=0
  TasksMax=100
  
  [Install]
  WantedBy=default.target
